description: Kendryte K230 and K230D: the boot ROM enters USB download mode when its storage holds nothing it can boot. Atlas loads Canaan's burner U-Boot at the record's load_address, and the burner writes the storage. No vendor tool at run time (written from Canaan's k230_flash). Untested on a board.
entry: Make sure the board's storage holds nothing it can boot: the boot ROM waits for USB only then.
Connect the board's USB OTG port to this computer, then power the board on.
The board appears as a K230 USB boot device (29f1:<pid>).

stages: usb-boot: the boot ROM takes Canaan's burner (the record's loader) and starts it at the record's load_address
burn: the burner writes the image to the record's medium from image_offset
confirm: the burner checksums the written image; a burner that can't checksum says so, then the board restarts
flash.loader_check: The SPL firmware heads in the image are checked (SHA-256) before every flash.

todo: Only the K230D's USB id 29f1:0230 is sourced (the bpi-canmv-k230d-zero record); the plain K230's download-mode PID is not.
The load address is per board: the official tools send 0x80360000, and Gaia's burner links at 0x80300000 (see the record).
